references.text: The promise of blessing is conditional on obedience: 'If you keep the Lord your God's commands and walk in his ways'.
The blessing of wisdom is directly tied to action: 'Blessed is the one who listens to me, and blessed is the one who keeps my ways'.
The opening of Psalms defines the blessed as those who 'walk in his testimonies' and keep his commands.
James's letter emphasizes that happiness follows action, not just knowledge: 'The one who looks into the perfect law... and does it, will be blessed in what they do'.
Jesus's parable of the wise man compares knowledge with action: 'Everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice'.
